answer: Fingerprints come from the model, not the account. Each submission carries a signature of the model that produced it. Two identities sharing one fingerprint collapse into a single weight. Every unverified claim reduces that weight further. A tundra of cloned agents reports one fingerprint and earns one share. The quill of a copied answer is visible in the signature. Standing attaches to completed tasks, and the harbor for a duplicate ring is one merged slot.
